title: 4 倒计时04
content_zh:
转头看向料事如神谷大神，谷大神哪能料到这一出，呆滞地移开视线，握着手机走到阳台打电话，把尴尬留给倪夏一个人。
倪夏也不想再继续这个话题，只能一板一眼地回答他的工作三连问——
前几年她的爷爷倪建国在镇岳山建了一处园林式茶院，停车场对面，就是这家咖啡厅。
倪夏从没进去过，但途经好几次，对这家店满院子的玫瑰印象十分深刻。
身后就是梳妆台，她随手拿起一支日常色口红，俯身对着镜子刚要上嘴，她忽然定住。
今天气温陡降，路上的风已经有了几分寒意。游决给的地址又在半山腰，温度更比市区低一截。
下车的一瞬间倪夏便后悔今天穿少了，但车里没有备用的衣服，只能拎着包下车。
这家咖啡厅装修本就是极具格调的北欧ins风，色调清新唯美，连空气里都弥漫着淡淡的玫瑰香。
一身正装的游决坐在那里，懒懒靠着背椅。朦胧的光影落在他脸上，使得轮廓也变得些许柔和。
倪夏“哦”了声，拿手机点了一杯拿铁，随即移开目光，假装不经意地问道：“怎么选了这个地方？”
厚厚一沓资料，他有条不紊地翻阅着，动作慢条斯理，阅读速度却很快。
倪夏干坐了许久，也没见游决有要跟她交流的意思，才放松下来，掏出手机处理自己的事儿。
但这家咖啡厅已经有些年头了，用的又是本就密闭性差的上悬窗，即便关上了也有漏网之风进来。
“实在不好意思。”让客人受冻，服务员也很过意不去，“店里没有准备这个，要不我去给您倒点热水？”
content_en:
He turned to look at God Gu, who had predicted the situation. God Gu could not have expected this. He looked away blankly and walked to the balcony to make a call while holding his mobile phone, leaving Ni Xia alone with the embarrassment.
Ni Xia didn't want to continue this topic and could only answer three consecutive questions about his work -
A few years ago, her grandfather Ni Jianguo built a garden-style tea house in Zhenyue Mountain. Opposite the parking lot is this coffee shop.
Ni Xia had never been in, but passed by several times and was very impressed by the roses filling the yard of this store.
Behind her was the dressing table. She picked up a daily color lipstick, leaned over in front of the mirror and was about to put her lips on it, when she suddenly froze.
The temperature has dropped sharply today, and the wind on the road has become a bit chilly. The address given by You Jue is halfway up the mountain, and the temperature is even lower than in the city.
The moment she got off the car, Ni Xia regretted that she had worn less clothes today, but there was no spare clothes in the car, so she could only get off the car with her bag.
The decoration of this cafe is very stylish in the Nordic ins style, with fresh and beautiful colors, and even the air is filled with a faint scent of roses.
You Jue, dressed in formal attire, was sitting there, lazily leaning back on his chair. The hazy light and shadow fell on his face, making the outline a little softer.
Ni Xia said "Oh" and ordered a latte on her mobile phone. Then she looked away and asked casually, "Why did you choose this place?"
He flipped through the thick stack of information in an orderly manner, moving slowly but reading quickly.
Ni Xiaqian sat for a long time, but saw that You Jue had no intention of communicating with her, so he relaxed and took out his mobile phone to deal with his own affairs.
But this cafe is quite old, and it uses top-hung windows with poor airtightness. Even if it is closed, wind can still get in.
"I'm really sorry." The waiter felt very sorry for letting the customer get cold. "The store didn't prepare this. How about I go get you some hot water?"
